Standard: A means exists of monitoring external surfaces and detecting ice accumulation by the flight crew or an automated system throughout the air vehicle's flight envelope. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review design documents, flight manuals, and technical data to verify that limits for ice accumulation or ice accretion rates are established to allow the flight crew or an automated system to actuate environmental protection systems as required for SOF. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct analysis to verify that ice detection systems or methods provide an indication of ice accretion before accumulation on critical surfaces and engine inlets results in loss of engine power or degradation of handling qualities beyond Level 2. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Conduct laboratory testing in an integration lab or icing tunnel to verify that ice detection indications (e.g., WCAs or an ice detection signal to automated ice protection systems) are initiated before critical accretion thresholds are exceeded. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
    (2) Flight test: Conduct flight testing to verify that ice detector indications occur before accretion on critical surfaces affects SOF.
